758:t_1:229.en:
$$クレア$$
「Thank you for coming out to greet us.」

758:t_1:230.en:
$$学園長$$
「Not at all... Thank you for all your hard work until today, Chairwoman.」

758:t_1:231.en:
$$モロイ$$
「We... made it back, didn't we.」

758:t_1:232.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「That $$時空修復|lc$$ brought us back to our original world, academy included.」

758:t_1:233.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Come to think of it, what happened to $$アクエリオン$$?」

758:t_1:234.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Does it matter? The fighting's over now.」

758:t_1:235.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Right. Besides, if fighting ever breaks out again...」

758:t_1:236.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Then $$アクエリオン$$ will surely rise again.」

758:t_1:237.en:
$$ユノハ$$
「What we should do now, in this world, is...」

758:t_1:238.en:
$$ジン$$
「To savor the peace with those we love.」

758:t_1:241.en:
$$ドナール$$
「Y-You guys... Dating between boys and girls is...!」

758:t_1:242.en:
$$スオミ$$
「That's been allowed for ages, hasn't it, Chairwoman?」

758:t_1:243.en:
$$クレア$$
「Yes. Even $$不動$$ has approved of it.」

758:t_1:244.en:
$$アンディ$$
「All right, $$ＭＩＸ$$! Let's show everyone at the academy how close we are!」

758:t_1:246.en:
$$クレア$$
「However, you are all still immature...! You still have so much to learn!」

758:t_1:247.en:
$$クレア$$
「Make what you gained in this battle your own... and with it, set out for all sorts of worlds...」

758:t_1:248.en:
$$クレア$$
「When you reunite with your comrades from $c, you will show them how much more you have grown.」

758:t_1:250.en:
$$カイエン$$
「All of the $$エレメント$$s wish to return to school.」

758:t_1:251.en:
$$クレア$$
「Very well. There, you will learn about true love.」

758:t_1:254.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Yes. If $$アマタ$$ is by my side, I... think I'll surely be able to find it.」

758:t_1:255.en:
$$アマタ$$
(I love you, $$ミコノ$$... Even 12,000 years from now, even 120 million years from now...)

758:t_1:265.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「Let's give a big round of applause once more to the two who have become husband and wife today.」

758:t_1:268.en:
$$リーロン$$
「Come to think of it, you two have been left waiting this whole time, haven't you.」

758:t_1:269.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「But now there's no one to get in your way, and no more fighting either!」

758:t_1:273.en:
$$キヤル$$
「You two are a perfect match!」

758:t_1:274.en:
$$キヨウ$$
「The two rings $$シモン$$ gave you... They look wonderful on you!」

758:t_1:275.en:
$$ニア$$
「This ring encouraged me, and I... was able to keep doing my best all this time.」

758:t_1:277.en:
$$ニア$$
「I'm the one who should be thanking you, $$シモン$$. We'll be together always from now on.」

758:t_1:278.en:
$$シモン$$
「Of course. Until the day our lives end...」

758:t_1:279.en:
$$シモン$$
「Compared to eternity, it may be a short time, but let's live that time to the fullest.」

758:t_1:281.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But are you sure, $$シモン$$? You're welcome to take it easy a little longer.」

758:t_1:282.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's right. You could put off your departure a bit and enjoy your newlywed life more.」

758:t_1:284.en:
$$シモン$$
「Exactly. We'll break through the heavens and dimensions alike, and our journey goes on.」

758:t_1:289.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
($$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$... Preparations to welcome you are about to begin...)

758:t_1:290.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
(I'm sure I won't get to see you, but in our place, that will say 'Welcome home' to you)

758:t_1:293.en:
???
「Should we address you as $$大統領$$ instead?」

758:t_1:295.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$タカヤ・ノリコ$$... I've just returned.」

758:t_1:296.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$オオタ・カズミ$$, likewise. We're both safe.」

758:t_1:297.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「What on earth is going on...!? And $$カズミ$$ has gotten younger!」

758:t_1:298.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll tell you all about that slowly, later.」

758:t_1:299.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Yes... About our battle that spanned 12,000 years...」

758:t_1:300.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「...After I went to all the trouble of preparing to welcome you as a world-scale project, it was all for nothing, huh...」

758:t_1:301.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not at all! Thanks to that, we were able to protect the universe!」

758:t_1:302.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Thank you, $$ユング#pilot$$. Your 'Welcome home'... it reached us, all right.」

758:t_1:303.en:
$$ユング#pilot$$
「But if we can meet again like this, let me say it once more.」

758:t_1:307.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I'll be waiting, everyone... Someday, come visit our world too.)

758:t_1:311.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Seriously, they work us hard. Putting us on a new mission right away.」

758:t_1:312.en:
$$カシオ$$
「There are no more $$宇宙怪獣$$ now. $$トップレス$$ has to find other work too.」

758:t_1:313.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Not just $$トップレス$$. That goes for all of humanity too.」

758:t_1:314.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Expanding beyond the solar system... And sending a delegation to the Independent Alliance $$シリウス$$ for the first time in millennia... Time that stood still is moving again.」

758:t_1:315.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's a wonderful thing, to take part in that delegation.」
